method: Read-only audit: read all 24 SKILL.md frontmatters+bodies, globbed scripts/schemas/references/resources/templates/agents trees in both .omp and .claude, grepped every concrete relative file reference and verified existence, and checked shared/ dirs for $SHARED_PATH refs.
headline_finding: ALL 24 SKILL.md files are loadable: valid frontmatter (name matches dir, non-empty description) + zero broken internal references + resources present in both harnesses. The .omp and .claude trees are structurally identical full-content mirrors. CRITICAL ARCHITECTURAL DEVIATION: the 12 .omp SKILL.md files are NOT thin-wrapper redirects to .claude as the architecture doc implies — each carries full duplicated content (standalone-loadable, but creates dual-maintenance drift risk). The '<this-skill-directory>' / 'SKILL_PATH=<...>' tokens that appear are path variables inside the skill body, not redirect stubs.
top_findings: PASS(loadability): 24/24 — every SKILL.md parses with valid YAML frontmatter; name matches directory; description non-empty.

PASS(refs): 0 broken references across all 24 files. Every scripts/*.mjs|*.py, schemas/*.json, references/*, resources/*, templates/*, agents/* path cited in a SKILL.md body resolves relative to its skill dir. All $SHARED_PATH/scripts/*.mjs and $SHARED_PATH/schemas/*.json refs resolve in both .omp/shared and .claude/shared.

WARN(architecture, .omp x12): No thin-wrapper redirect to .claude found in any .omp SKILL.md. All 12 .omp files are full-content duplicates of .claude (verified identical frontmatter + matching line counts + identical resource trees). This contradicts the documented '.omp=thin wrapper -> .claude=full' design and means the two trees can diverge silently. Not a loadability failure — every .omp skill loads standalone — but a maintenance/governance hazard worth flagging.

INFO(resource shape, both harnesses identical): heaviest skills = industrial-analysis-auto (6 .mjs, 16 schemas, resources only) and industrial-data-processor (4 .mjs + 8 .py, 5 schemas). Lightest = darwin-skill (SKILL.md + results.tsv only, meta-skill). industrial-html-reviewer/html-visualizer/physical-auditor/ontology-builder are doc+schema only (no .mjs).

INFO: rag-knowledge-builder and industrial-analysis-auto use resources/ (not references/) as their on-demand-reference dir; both correctly resolve. diagnostic-html-visualizer correctly carries references/report-template.html + agents/ + templates/ in both trees.
